programs.description: Bringing the best in television.
A comprehensive compilation of melodious songs recorded by talented artists, musicians and singers from popular Telugu movies, played back to back.
Bringing the best in television.
A comprehensive compilation of melodious songs sung and composed by talented artists is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion.
A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs sung to express veneration for divine figures in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace and calm in devotees.

The host provides the latest information, advancements and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues.
An expert astrologer offers astrological advice based on the zodiac signs and explains the planetary movements and their impact.
After experiencing discrimination based on religion and caste, Sai Baba endures various trials and tribulations on his journey to promote peace and love in society.
When Lord Shiva beheads Lord Ganesha, unaware of the fact that he is his son, Goddess Parvati asks Shiva to resurrect him. Later, Lord Ganesha is then renamed Vighnaharta, the remover of obstacles.

While a girl's parents search for suitable marriage proposals, fate directs her to meet a young man whom she is destined to marry.
Kanthara, a simple girl, strives to navigate multiple challenges when her childhood love leaves the village in order to make a future.
An entanglement of emotions cause pain and suffering as a daughter seeks a mother's love and a mother yearns for a caring daughter.
Driven by her maternal instincts and a determination to protect her family, Durga, who works as a lecturer, sets out to save her son Murari from danger.
Deepa is a girl with a broken marriage and also the sole earner of her family. Moreover, her brother-in-law is the culprit behind her troubles.
After their first meet, Balu and Sailaja stage their marriage to escape a sticky situation. Eventually, their discord eases and they find themselves drawn to each other.
